names.name: Parsley Piert, Or Parsley Break Stone
names.note: Small prostrate plant with parsley-like leaves: parsley piert.

cul:224-parsley-piert-or-parsley-break-s.ref: Culpeper, Complete Herbal: Parsley Piert, Or Parsley Break Stone
cul:224-parsley-piert-or-parsley-break-s.headword: Parsley Piert, Or Parsley Break Stone
cul:224-parsley-piert-or-parsley-break-s.text: Its operation is very prevalent to provoke urine, and to break the stone. It is a very good sallad herb. It were good the gentry would pickle it up as they pickle up Samphire for their use all the Winter. I cannot teach them how to do it; yet this I can tell them, it is a very wholesome herb. They may also keep the herb dry, or in a syrup, if they please. You may take a dram of the powder of it in white wine; it would bring away gravel from the kidneys insensibly, and without pain. It also helps the stranguary.
